// Everything on the FX chip. ../../run.sh makes fxdata.bin and fxdata.h from it with tools/fxdata-build.py.
// Pictures from tools/graysprite.py: 4 size bytes, then 3 frames per picture (one per gray layer),
// a mask byte after each picture byte. Draw with MODE_PLUSMASKFX, frame*3 + currentPlane().
// All files here except this one are made by run.sh. Do not edit them.
include "maps.txt"       // tools/mapconv.py: the maps, mapBlocks (baked map pictures, no mask) and mapTops
include "cursor.txt"     // 48x24
include "marks.txt"      // owner marks, 8x8: player 1, player 2
include "unitsA.txt"     // player 1 units, 24x24, 16 kinds
include "unitsB.txt"     // player 2 units
include "unitsADone.txt" // player 1 units that are done for the turn: a dark gray checker over them
include "unitsBDone.txt"
include "sandbags.txt"   // 24x8, over the feet of a fortified unit
include "fogWang.txt"    // fog edge masks 1-14, 48x24, 144 bytes each, no picture
